title: Tag pills — words lined up with icons

steps.path: Click the tag element in the bottom status bar
steps.headline: The old diagonal tag icon is back, and each tag's word now sits level with the icon and the round ×/+.
steps.changed: These pictures are at your screen's 1.5× scale; my earlier ones were at 1×, which hid the problem. This font centres CAPITALS in the line, so lowercase words like "work" hung low. Words are now centred on their lowercase letters.
steps.measured: word was 1.5 screen px below the icon and ×; now within 0.5
steps.notice: Icon, word and × read as one line in every tag pill.
steps.risk: A tag with a capital letter still centres on its capitals, as before — only all-lowercase words moved.

steps.path: Click the session name at the top of the window
steps.headline: The same fix in the session list, beside the Working pill.
steps.changed: Every tag pill in the app uses it.
steps.notice: Tag pills and status pills line up the same way.

steps.path: Conversation cards Claude shows in a reply
steps.headline: Tags with capitals ("UI", "Follow-Up Needed") keep their old centring, which already looked right.
steps.changed: Only all-lowercase words were moved; any word with a capital centres on its capitals as before.
